functions.name: done2
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete upstream end.c done2() definition (90-153). The implementation preserves the tutorial y_n() confirmation, ParanoidQuit query, prompt cleanup, cursor restoration, wait synchronization, positive multi interruption, zero-state invulnerability and sleep reset, tutorial schedule_goto(), wizard Dump core? query, stopprint increment for q, and final done(QUIT) call in source order. The browser has no signal disposition or process core-dump operation; the y core-dump branch remains an explicit UnsupportedEndOfGameError boundary. No random-number call is made by done2().

callers.source: cmd.c doextcmd() resolves the extcmdlist[] quit row and invokes its done2 function; the JavaScript switch dispatches the row to done2(state), returning its ECMD result to rhack().
cmd.c rhack() dispatches the key bound to doextcmd(), and its ECMD_OK result resets command state after done2() cancels the quit.

entryPointReview: The selected range has one production entry point: the cmd.c extcmdlist[] quit row is selected by the #quit prompt, cmd.c doextcmd() invokes done2(), and the cancellation recording reaches the prompt cleanup and ECMD_OK return. Focused tests also execute the tutorial and accepted branches, with accepted ordinary quit stopping at the existing done(QUIT) boundary.
